6322.d: Vaade ülalt kõrgelt kaldalt merele. Ees vasakul üksiku kuuse juures selgvaates mees. Paremal kuuskede grupp. Taamal meri.
6322.de: View from a high shore down onto the sea. In front on the left, by a solitary spruce, a man seen clearly. On the right a group of spruces. In the distance, the sea.

6326.d: Mehe rinnapilt, poolprofiilis paremale. Sinine kuub ja aumärk-rist kaelas.
6326.de: Bust portrait of a man, in half-profile to the right. Blue coat and a cross-shaped medal on his neck.

6329.d: Üle lagendiku vaade taga kõrgendiku jalal olevale linnale ja selle tipul olevatele lossivaremetele. Kolmveerandiku tööst moodustab pilvine taevas.
6329.de: A view across a clearing to a town in the background on the foot of a rise and, on its summit, castle ruins. Three-quarters of the work is made up of a cloudy sky.

6331.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt, poolprofiilis paremale. Põskhabe, seljas must kuub ja must kaelaside.
6331.de: Bust portrait of an older man, in half-profile to the right. Side-whiskers, wearing a black coat and a black cravat.

6337.d: Keskel punase linaga kaetud laua ümber perekond. Laua taga sohval istuvad isa ja ema, nende ees laual väike tüdruk ja laua kõrval seismas teine. Käsitoel, ema selja taga kolmas. Eespool lauda vasakul toolil istub üliõpilase vormis noormees. Paremal kolm poissi, neist üks koolpoisi vormikuues. Poiste selja taga seismas vana naine.
6337.de: In the middle, a family around a table covered with a red cloth. Behind the table, father and mother sit on a sofa, in front of them on the table a small girl and another standing beside the table. On the armrest, behind the mother's back, a third one. In front of the table on the left, a young man in a student's uniform sits on a chair. On the right three boys, one of them in a schoolboy's uniform coat. Behind the boys' backs stands an old woman.

6467.d: Narmasõlakutega mereväeparaadkuues noormehe põlvpilt peaaegu enface. Parem käsi toetatud ankru ristpuule.
6467.de: Knee-length portrait of a young man in a naval dress uniform with fringed epaulettes, almost en face. Right hand resting on the crossbar of an anchor.

6549.d: Merelaht, mille ees väikeste põõsastega rand.
6549.de: Sea bay with a shore lined with small bushes in front.

6550.d: Esiplaanilt keskelt pildi sügavusse suunduv kõrgete puudega ääristatud tee, kus jalutab mees koeraga.
6550.de: A path lined with tall trees leading from the middle foreground into the depth of the picture, where a man is walking with a dog.

6551.d: Vaade kõrgetest mägedest piiratud järvele. Esiplaanil vasakul kaldariba puudega.
6551.de: View of a lake enclosed by high mountains. In the foreground on the left a strip of shore with trees.

6585.d: Mehe poolfiguur, pea poolprofiilis vasakule. Põskhabe, juuksed püstihoidvana. Mundris, ordenipaela ja ordenitega. Käed kehast eemal.
6585.de: Half-figure of a man, head in half-profile to the left. Side whiskers, hair standing upright. In uniform, with an order ribbon and orders. Hands held away from the body.

6783.d: Esiplaanil rahvarõivais mees ja naine. Nende vahel väike valges särgis laps. Naisel käes lehter. Tagplaanil vasakul kõrtsihoone, paremal mööda teed sõitev hobune vankriga, eemal künkal veski.
6783.de: In the foreground a man and a woman in folk costume. Between them a small child in a white shirt. The woman holds a funnel. In the background on the left an inn building, on the right a horse with a cart driving along the road, in the distance a mill on a hill.

6784.d: Madal talutare tantsivate paaridega. Paremal kaabuga torupilli mängija. Esiplaanil keskel laps ajab vitsaga põrsast taga.
6784.de: A low farmhouse with dancing couples. On the right a bagpipe player wearing a hat. In the foreground in the centre, a child chasing a piglet with a switch.

7201.d: Vanema naise poolfiguur istuvas asendis, kerge pöördega paremale, hallikassinises valge pitskraega kleidis, valges kogu nägu ümbritsevas tülltanus, õlgadel kirju rätik. Käed vaheliti süles.
7201.de: Half-figure of an older woman in a seated position, with a slight turn to the right, in a greyish-blue dress with a white lace collar, in a white tulle bonnet surrounding the whole face, a patterned shawl on the shoulders. Hands crossed in the lap.

7205.d: Põskhabemega mehe poolfiguur veerandprofiilis paremale. Silmad sinakad, nägu täidlane. Seljas tume, eest lahtine kuub ja eest kinninööbitud (5 nööpi) vest. Valge kaelus, tume kaelaside, mille üle nähtav valge krae äär.
7205.de: Half-figure of a bearded man in three-quarter profile facing right. Bluish eyes, full face. Wearing a dark coat open at the front and a waistcoat buttoned at the front (5 buttons). White collar, dark necktie, over which the white edge of the collar is visible.

7335.d: Esiplaanil oja kaldal kaks rahvariides istuvat naisfiguuri. Nende seljataga jämeda puutüve tagant vasakul piilub kaabus noormees. Paremal tagaplaanil järv paadiga kaldal ning suur kask.
7335.de: In the foreground on the bank of a stream two seated female figures in national costume. Behind them, from behind a thick tree trunk on the left, a young man in a hat peeks out. In the background on the right a lake with a boat on the shore and a large birch.

7337.d: Suure kaarvärava juures kaks eesti rahvuslikes seelikutes ja käistes naist. Parempoolne, sirbiga käes, seisasb eredas päikesevalguses, vasakpoolne istub varjus.
7337.de: By a large arched gate, two women in Estonian national skirts and sleeves. The one on the right, holding a sickle, stands in bright sunlight; the one on the left sits in shadow.

7380.d: Esiplaanil vasemal paekivi, paremal merd vaatlev selgvaates naisfiguur pikas kleidis. Keskplaanil vasakul kaljurahn, paremal veepind kividega. Veel üksik paat kahe sõitjaga. Keskplaanil keskel üksik puu. Puu taga horisondil mets. Taeva allosas paremal pilvede tagant osalt nähtav kuuketas.
7380.de: In the foreground on the left, limestone; on the right, a female figure in full view, in a long dress, looking at the sea. In the middle ground on the left, a rocky boulder, on the right a water surface with stones. Also a single boat with two passengers. In the centre of the middle ground a solitary tree. Behind the tree, forest on the horizon. In the lower part of the sky on the right, the moon disc partly visible behind clouds.

7498.d: Ees paremal tallipoiss hoidmas keskel latrite ees seisvat tumehalli hobust, taga latrites kolm hobust; vasakul ees hobuste tekke.
7498.de: In front on the right a stable boy holding a dark grey horse standing in the middle in front of the stalls, behind in the stalls three horses; in front on the left horse blankets.

7578.d: Ees jõgi millest vasakul üks haru paremale veski taha suundub. Vastaskaldal, keskel veski koos kõrvalhoonetega, vasemal sild; silla juures sõudepaat.
7578.de: In front a river, on the left one branch turns right behind the mill. On the opposite bank, in the centre a mill with outbuildings, on the left a bridge; by the bridge a rowing boat.

7579.d: Ees veekogu. Keskel veski koos rea kõrvalhoonetega. Vasemal paadisild. Sillal kaks poisikese figuuri. 2/3 tööst pilvist taevast.
7579.de: In front a body of water. In the middle a mill with a row of outbuildings. On the left a boat bridge. On the bridge two boy figures. 2/3 of the work cloudy sky.

7711.d: Istuva naise poolfiguur - en face. Peas valge, rüüžidega tanu. Käed vaheliti rüpes.
7711.de: Half-figure of a seated woman, en face. On her head a white bonnet with ruffles. Hands crossed in her lap.

7719.d: Kolme väikese tüdruku poolfiguurid grupina istumas. Parempoolsel süles pikakarvaline koer.
7719.de: Half-figures of three small girls sitting as a group. On the right one's lap a long-haired dog.

7813.de: In the foreground, in the centre, a group of dancers in folk costume, on the left male figures with a violinist in the middle, on the right a young couple sitting at a table - the groom in a light blue coat, the bride wreathed. The farmhouse room decorated with greenery.

7822.d: Noor naine valges siidikleidis kinkidega laua taga. Vasakus käes kollane siidirätik. Laual tort, roosid ja karp ehetega. Naise vaade suunatud kollase siidirätiku ülemise serva poole.
7822.de: A young woman in a white silk dress at a table with gifts. In her left hand a yellow silk scarf. On the table a cake, roses and a box with jewelry. The woman's gaze directed toward the upper edge of the yellow silk scarf.

7841.d: Esiplaanil kaks poissi kirsse ostmas noorelt naiselt, kelle kõrval seisab noormees, paremal sammastega hoone.
7841.de: In the foreground two boys buying cherries from a young woman, next to whom stands a young man, on the right a building with columns.

7842.d: Tumepruuni värvi hobuse figuur täisprofiilis vasakule, seotud posti külge.
7842.de: Figure of a dark brown horse in full profile to the left, tied to a post.

8115.d: Vanema mehe rindportree veerandpöördes vasakule, pilk vaatajal. Mehel hõre põskhabe, paljas otsmik, sinised silmad. Seljas kuldnööpidega sinine kuub, aumärk rinnas, kaelusest paistab valge žaboo.
8115.de: Bust portrait of an older man, three-quarter turned to the left, gaze on the viewer. The man has a sparse side-beard, a bare forehead, blue eyes. Wearing a blue coat with gilt buttons, a decoration on the chest, a white jabot visible at the collar.

8540.d: Künklik talvemaastik. Esiplaanil paremal värav, vasakul külmunud veeloigud. Keskosas teel liikumas jalakäijad ja hobusemehi, suunaga taamal asetsevate linnuse varemete poole, mille tagant paistab kirik.
8540.de: A hilly winter landscape. In the foreground on the right a gate, on the left frozen puddles. In the middle part, on the road, pedestrians and horsemen moving, heading towards castle ruins situated in the distance, behind which a church is visible.

8831.d: Heledapäise rohelises pluusis poisikese rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule.
8831.de: Bust portrait of a fair-haired boy in a green blouse, in half-profile to the left.

9055.d: Keskealise naise rinnafiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Seljas hall avara dekolteega kleit, peas pitstanu.
9055.de: Bust figure of a middle-aged woman in a slight turn to the left. Wearing a grey dress with a wide décolletage, a lace cap on her head.

9184.d: Vanema mehe rinnapilt poolprofiilis paremale, hallide käharate juuste ja tumeda ülikonnaga. Taustaks maastik - õlgkatusega majake ja naisefiguur puu all paremal.
9184.de: Bust of an older man in half-profile to the right, with grey curly hair and a dark suit. Background is a landscape - a small thatched-roof house and a female figure under a tree on the right.

9284.d: Interjööris istuva mehe täisfiguur poolprofiilis paremale, parem käsi toetatud rohelise kattega lauale. Uksest avaneb vaade kõrvalruumidesse. Figuuri taga seinal musta riidega kaetud tsaariportree (ilmselt Nikolai I).
9284.de: Full figure of a man seated in an interior, in half-profile to the right, right hand resting on a table with a green cover. Through a door a view opens into adjoining rooms. Behind the figure on the wall a portrait of the tsar (apparently Nicholas I) covered with black cloth.

9325.d: Keskealise naise poolfiguur täisprofiilis paremale. Peas triibuline rätik, mille alumine serv ripub lihtsalt üle õlgade seljale. Üle halli jaki punane pihik.
9325.de: Half-figure of a middle-aged woman in full profile facing right. A striped kerchief on her head, its lower edge simply hanging over her shoulders onto her back. A red bodice over a grey jacket.

9790.d: Eest taha suunudval kitsal rohtunud kaljuplatool sööv ja mäletsev kari. Paremal näha allapoole laskuval kaldal kasvavate puude latvu. Vasakul künkaline kaljukallas.
9790.de: On a narrow grassy rocky plateau receding from front to back, a herd grazing and ruminating. On the right the treetops of trees growing on a bank descending downward are visible. On the left a hilly rocky bank.

9795.d: Ees taha vasakule suunduv jõgi. Vasakul paat sõudjatega. Vastaskaldal pooldeldi vees põõsastikuriba, mille tagant tõuseb järsk kallas selle harjale viiva trepiga vasakul. Kaldaharjal kirik. Taga vasakul üksik kivihoone.
9795.de: In front a river running back to the left. On the left a boat with rowers. On the opposite bank a strip of shrubbery half in the water, behind which rises a steep bank with steps leading up to its ridge on the left. On the ridge of the bank a church. Behind on the left a solitary stone building.

9993.d: Vasakul kallas suurte kivirahnudega, paremal jõekäär madala vastaskaldaga, taamal sinavad mäed.
9993.de: On the left a bank with large boulders, on the right a river bend with a low opposite bank, in the distance bluish mountains.

10092.de: In front on the left, a man with a horse before the open door of a smithy; on the right a steep sandy bank. Behind it farm buildings. In the distance a moraine landscape sinking into dusk.

10204.d: Järv. Paremal kallas (Sõsarsaare serv) lehestikuga ja haralise vana pajuga, mille üks haru ulatub horisontaalsuunas veepinna kohale. Vasakult paistab Kloostrisaar.

10851.d: Haige põetamise olmestseen ajaloolises interjööris. Kompositsiooni keskel kolm naisfiguuri: üks vanem daam lamab voodis, teine istub toolil näoga haige poole ning kolmas seisab profiilis voodi kõrval, käes valge anum.
10851.de: A genre scene of nursing a patient in a historical interior. In the centre of the composition three female figures: one older lady lies in bed, another sits on a chair facing the patient, and a third stands in profile beside the bed, holding a white vessel.

48573.d:
Niguliste kiriku Roseni kabeli interjöör, keset ruumi monument klaasist sarkofaagiga.
Kabeli usteks oli Roseni kabeli ehissein, mis praegu on Niguliste kiriku tornialuses ruumis. Kabel  pole säilinud, see oli väike ruum, mis asus Põhjaeeskoha idaosas praeguse trepikäigu asukohal. Tagaplaanil olevad aknad on alles ja samasugused. 
Merike Kurisoo andmed
48573.de:
The interior of the Rosen Chapel in St. Nicholas' Church, in the middle of the room a monument with a glass sarcophagus.
The doors of the chapel were the decorative wall of the Rosen Chapel, which is currently located in the tower room of St. Nicholas' Church. The chapel has not survived, it was a small room located at the site of the current staircase in the eastern part of the North Sacristy. The windows in the background have survived and are the same. 
Data by Merike Kurisoo

64911.d: Varreotsal graveeritud taimemotiiv ja rombikujuline lint initsiaalidega EV.

64918.d: Suhkrutoosi kere jaotub eenduvate püstjoonte abil kuueks väljaks, toosi ülaservas stantsitud ornament keerduvate taimelehtedega. Kaas jaotub samuti kuueks väljaks, servas lusikaava. Kaanenupp sile ja ümar, vaheketas mustaks värvitud puidust. Madalal jalal on looklev serv.
64918.de: The body of the sugar bowl is divided by projecting vertical lines into six fields, on the upper rim of the bowl a stamped ornament with curling plant leaves. The lid is likewise divided into six fields, with a spoon-shaped rim edge. The knob of the lid is smooth and round, the intermediate disc of wood painted black. The low foot has a wavy edge.

64927.d: Kannu alumine pool on kaunistatud rõõnetega, nende kohal on graveeritud ornamendiriba. Sang on kujundatud maona, mille selg on kaunistatud reljeefsete rombidega ja kõht lülidega, mao graveeritud pea kinnitub kannu ava külge. Madal, ovaalse kujuga jalg on profileeritud.
64927.de: The lower part of the jug is decorated with fluting, above which is an engraved ornamental band. The handle is shaped as a snake, whose back is decorated with relief rhombuses and whose belly is decorated with segments, the snake's engraved head attaches to the mouth of the jug. The low, oval-shaped foot is profiled.

64950.d: Korv on kitsaste eenduvate ribade abil jaotatud kaheksaks. Korvi serva kaunistab stantsitud ornament keerduvate taimelehtede ja teokarbimotiividega. Sanga keskosas reljeefne palmett, mille keskel on väike nupp, sanga mõlemas otsas stiliseeritud leht. Ovaalne jalg jaotub kaheksaks siiruks.
64950.de: The basket is divided into eight by narrow protruding ribs. The rim of the basket is decorated with a stamped ornament of curling plant leaves and shell motifs. In the middle part of the handle a relief palmette, in the centre of which is a small knob, at each end of the handle a stylised leaf. The oval foot is divided into eight sections.

64958.d: Varreotsal graveeritud nimetähed A. G. Varre tagaküljele graveeritud daatum: d 1 Decbr 1849.

64968.d: Vahaaluste serva ümbritseb stantsitud ornamendiriba keerduvate taimelehtedega.

64969.d: Vahaaluste serva ümbritseb stantsitud ornamendiriba keerduvate taimelehtedega.

65028.d: Ristkülikukujuline vaagen toetub võrdlemisi kõrgele jalale, mille ülaosa ümbritseb krae. Vaagna serva kaunistab stantsitud ornament keerduvate taimelehtedega. Vaagna ja jala ühenduskohas on kitsas ornamendiriba naturalistliku lilldekooriga. Kõrvalestakujulised sangad lõppevad spiraaliga. Eset võidi kasutada maiustuste korvina.
65028.de: A rectangular dish rests on a relatively tall foot, the upper part of which is surrounded by a collar. The rim of the dish is decorated with a stamped ornament of curling plant leaves. At the junction of the dish and the foot there is a narrow ornamental band with naturalistic floral decoration. The ear-shaped handles end in a spiral. The object may have been used as a basket for sweets.

65034.d: Keret ja kaane serva kaunistab kitsas geomeetrilise ornamendiga riba. Kaanenupp ja sang on mustaks värvitud puidust.

65704.dm: lehe laius: 17.0 cm; lehe kõrgus: 20.9 cm
65704.d: Wilhelm von Kügelgen kuulus Eestis mõjukasse Kügelgenide kunstnikedünastiasse ja on ka ise jätnud jälje siinsesse kunstilukku. Tema õrn ja visandlik joonistus oma pojast Bennost omab seetõttu nii kultuuri- kui kunstiloolist tähtsust, täiendades Eesti Kunstimuuseumi baltisaksa joonistuste kollektsiooni.
65704.de: Wilhelm von Kügelgen belonged to the influential Kügelgen dynasty of artists in Estonia and has himself also left a mark on the local art history. His delicate and sketchy drawing of his son Benno therefore has both cultural and art-historical significance, complementing the Art Museum of Estonia's collection of Baltic German drawings.
